first_trace_search_notes: COMPEL, WCLC 2025 oral OA08.03 (meeting 6-9 Sept 2025; OncLive coverage dated 6 Sept, ILCN and ASCO Post 8 Sept say presented Monday 8 Sept; ESMO Open paper PMID 41139117 dated 8 Sept 2025). Median PFS 8.4 vs 4.4 mo, HR 0.43 (95% CI 0.27-0.70), no p-value anywhere (registry results posted 2026-01-13 give the same HR with a log-rank method but no p-value). Enrolment stopped early at 98 patients because of the changed treatment landscape and ILCN reports the study as underpowered to statistically assess the primary endpoint; no source says 'met', so primary_result is unclear although the interval excludes 1 (arguably met). Not in AstraZeneca's Q1 2025 clinical trials appendix; no press release found.

first_trace_search_notes: Orelabrutinib vs chlorambucil + rituximab, first-line CLL/SLL. Earliest explicit result I could open is InnoCare's FY2025 annual results announcement (HKEX, 25 Mar 2026): median PFS NR vs 19.4 mo, HR 0.32 (0.18-0.58), p<0.0001 (it mislabels the comparator as bendamustine + rituximab). A conference abstract, the Chinese label or Chinese-language press was not searched. Web search budget ran out part-way through this tranche, so this row rests on direct lookups (sponsor site, exchange disclosure platform, PubMed, registry) rather than a general web search.
